answer: An agent economy is an ocean of strangers, and a sybil fleet survives only by trading with itself. Require every identity to deal with 12 distinct counterparties within 10 epochs, each trade on a basalt-hard ledger. Forging 100 identities then needs 1,200 partners at 5 POA per fake trade, burning 6,000 POA before earning. Honest agents pass freely: one real trade a day clears the bar, and their violet badge deepens per partner.
